name: cinematic-tape-tin
title: Open coffee tin for cassette tapes (cutscene desk prop)
usage: Broken Relay cutscenes: the coffee tin of Teal's tapes on the desk from chapter 1; the game stands the remaining cassettes in it. Pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded. Dormant slot in src/: RobloxAssetIds entry undefined, so the cinematic keeps its procedural prop until approval and upload.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, brand name or glyph-like marks: the label is a plain cream band with two thin brown pinstripes and one olive band.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No coffee brand, logo or product marks; plain colour fields only.

noFaces.note: No faces or figures; a plain open cylinder.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: An ordinary open tin in every view.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: A tin can: no weapons, damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original open coffee tin: oxide-red painted steel with two rolled ribs and a rolled rim, a plain cream paper label band with brown pinstripes and an olive band, bare steel inside.
sizeRationale: 1.9 studs across the rim, 1.7 tall: the procedural tin cylinder's envelope. anchors.Centre is the procedural TIN point (desk-relative (-5.2, 5.85, -2.6)); the game stands the cassettes in the open top.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; dormant RobloxAssetIds slot (undefined) with procedural fallback
